svg.text: PR #1880 · Context-gauge docs describe the wire-resolved window; closes the fidelity tracker
The gauge-fidelity tracker listed three local approximations of CLI-internal tables; the CLI's
own resolved window now rides the wire, so the gaps are closed and the docs catch up.

g.text: the gauge denominator, approximated locally
window derived from the model id on the portal side:
[1m] tag → hand-copied native_1m table → env var → 200k
the CLI's real resolution (mZc) also checks entitlement + provider
gating we cannot see, and the env var lives on the agent's host
tracked gaps (#1529)
1 · native_1m invisible → 1M models read 5x fuller
2 · CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS read on the wrong host
4 · codex line printed the cumulative thread total as occupancy
and docs that told the old story
"Claude leaves it None and the window is derived from the model id"
turn_tracker.rs + model_version.rs still described the approximation era
the CLI's own answer rides the wire
ResultMessage.model_usage[model].context_window →
reported_model_context_window (proxy) → TurnMetrics
capability-, entitlement-, provider- and env-aware — resolved on the
agent's own host; items 1 and 2 closed for every new turn
item 4 was already fixed in the renderer
the visible stat is the per-turn context snapshot
the cumulative thread total is tooltip-only, labeled as such
this PR: the docs catch up, behavior unchanged
wire-first resolution stated where it lives; the model map is fallback
fallback still serves rows recorded before proxies forwarded the value

svg.text: The model-id map itself stays for legacy rows — its demotion to a frozen fallback is #1533's own PR, next in this batch.
